document: T21 Beta seed layers: derivable (machine-generated) vs forward_declared (T22/T23 owner-tracked)
policy: The derivable layer must be 100% reproducible from committed artifacts. Any manual entry in the derivable layer is a bug. The forward_declared layer documents seeds that do not yet have a measurable reaching path; every entry must carry an owner card and a recheck point.

derivable.description: Seeds that are derivable from committed artifacts: worldgen ore veins, T5 terminal closure, registered energy/logistics objects, and the T21-C reachable-identity closure. Zero manual entries.
source_artifacts: tools/t21_operand_reachability.json (2,163 reachable item identities via item-only convergence)

forward_declared.description: Seeds that depend on not-yet-implemented subsystems. Every entry carries owner, reason, and recheck point. These seeds are NOT included in the lower bound; they are only used to estimate the upper bound.

entries.reason: Petroleum distillation family requires crude oil fluid extraction from subsurface deposits. The T11 deposit marker identity exists, but petroleum chemistry templates are not yet published.
Natural gas generification and direct-electric fuel generators require published petroleum families.
Oil sand processing requires petroleum family publication; source rows exist in fixed GT6 revision but are not yet projected to CC.
entries.recheck_point: T22b full projection per selected petroleum families

entries.reason: Oil shale processing requires petroleum family publication.
entries.recheck_point: T22b full projection per selected petroleum families

entries.reason: Petroleum coke is a petroleum byproduct; requires distillation family publication.
entries.recheck_point: T22c player loop (at least three downstream products)

entries.reason: Sulfuric acid production chain depends on petroleum sulfur byproducts; may also be served by non-petroleum routes (T5 chemical). Needs T22 petroleum closure to determine.
Titanium processing (Kroll process) requires a multiblock industrial blast furnace or equivalent controlled-atmosphere reactor. The machine kind is in the T23 multiblock classification scope.
Tungsten reduction from oxide requires hydrogen atmosphere multiblock furnace. Not implementable with current single-block processing machines.

lower_bound.v1_template_description: Gunpowder Mixer family (4 members: coal, charcoal, carbon, coal_coke)
lower_bound.method: Build closure from derivable seeds only; no forward-declared or petroleum entries.
lower_bound.note: The number 1 is reproducible: rerunning the closure with the same derivable seed set produces the same result.

upper_bound.v1_required_templates: To be determined by actual T22/T23 implementation — not estimated here
upper_bound.method: Forward-declared seeds are added. The actual v1 template count will change when T22/T23 publish their families and register their machine/energy identities.
upper_bound.warning: This is NOT a firm upper bound; it only reflects the current forward-declared list. New v1-required families may emerge when T22/T23 implement their subsystems.

archive_revision_policy.current_wording: 唯一 v1-required unit 是 4-row gunpowder Mixer family
archive_revision_policy.recommended_wording: 由 derivable seed 自动闭包得出 1 个 v1-required template（gunpowder Mixer family, 4 members）；forward_declared 层另有 8 个材料 seed 待 T22/T23 确认。Derivable 层 100% 由 tools/t21_operand_reachability.py 从已提交 artifact 生成，无人工条目。Forward_declared 层每项有 owner、reason 和 recheck point。T22/T23 开工时必须回头重算闭包。
